name: ariadne-38059a47-blind20-v2-ots
instr:
# Ariadne: nineteen behavioural regressions to find without a test suite

The repository has received 19 separate undocumented edits.

A service built on this library reads what a client sends over the web, answers it from an
API the author declares, reports on its own work while it runs, and pulls related rows out
of a database on the way. It now gets all of that wrong in a number of places. Nothing
about the protocol changed and nothing about the callers changed; the same requests that
used to be served correctly are answered wrongly, and in several places a request that used
to be served is refused outright while one that used to be refused now goes through.

A client sending an operation together with binary parts and a map saying where each part
belongs no longer gets the two merged: pointing a part at a field of a nested input value,
at an element of a list, at several elements of one list, or at fields within a list of
nested values all fail to produce the payload with the parts substituted in, and delivering
such a body over the web fails outright too. A body posted with a text/plain type, or with
none at all, is rejected with different wording than it used to produce. Work carried in
the query string of a GET, with that feature switched on, no longer runs: a valid one
returns no data, badly serialized argument values no longer draw the specific complaint
about that argument, and an operation that modifies state, named in such a URL, is happily
